Description: State St work, 1st-17th Ave, 6am-6pm Mon-Sat. Night work 1st-8th, 6pm-6am (none week of 8/17, back 8/24 for final paving). Expect lane shifts, flagging, side street closures. 1st, 4th, 5th, 9th, 15th open 6am-6pm. Info: sgystatestreet.com
Details: Work continues on State Street between 1st and 17th avenues from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday through Saturday. Night crews will keep reconstructing the roadway between 1st and 8th avenues from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., Monday through Saturday. No night work is planned for the week of August 17. It resumes the week of August 24 for final paving. Expect new traffic patterns, lane shifts, flagging, and multiple temporary side street and alley closures along State Street. Intersections at 1st, 4th, 5th, 9th, and 15th will stay open from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily. Check the message boards on State Street for current side street closures, and follow vehicle and pedestrian detours or use alternate routes. For more information, visit sgystatestreet.com.

Description: JNU Loop Rd: Night paving work with lane closures continue this week, minor delays expected. Info: 511.alaska.gov
Details: Week of August 16, crews will remove and replace the remaining asphalt surface within the project limits. This work requires lane closures and will occur at night to reduce impacts to the traveling public, with minor delays expected.
